note: Schema documents describe the authoring contract. They are documentation: the loader skips content/schemas/ and they do not affect the catalog hash.

units.power: integer power-unit milli-units; power is never a stored commodity
units.no_floating_point: the loader rejects fractional and exponent literals outright

identifiers: lowercase ASCII letters, digits and underscore; 1..64 characters

CompareMetric.metric: see docs/metrics.md for the readable set
CompareMetric.op: lt, lte, gt, gte, eq, neq

effects.faction: optional; the effect applies only under that faction

events[].chain_id: defaults to the event id; caps one chain per planet
events[].applies_to_facility: for facility scope, restricts the trigger to one facility type
events[].consecutive_days: the condition must hold this many consecutive days
events[].condition_resolved: evaluated daily while open; closes the instance through on_resolve
events[].decision_deadline_days: days the player has to choose; 0 means no decision window
events[].cooldown_days: days before the same event may reopen on that planet
events[].sector_unique: at most one open instance across the sector
events[].expire_keeps_open: on expiry, drop the deadline but keep the remedies selectable

choices[].cost: resource map paid from local available stock
choices[].cancels_scheduled_from: choice ids whose not-yet-due consequences this cancels
